title: atlax claims on this laptop (the facts the record's indexer reads)
description: Hestia ruled (hestia working-on/atlax-claims.md, decide 1(a), Pablo 2026-10-31): claims travel as facts of kind atlax_claim and atlax_claim_released through the laptop's facts ledger and its forwarder. As the forecast extensions do (forecast-state.json), `atlax claim` and `atlax release` write them to a folder of the laptop, ~/.local/state/factory/atlax-claims/<initiative>.<card>.<artifact>.json (ATLAX_CLAIMS overrides the folder; <name>.json.tmp is the writer's atomic-replace temp and is never read), one file per claim key (card + artifact), its facts appended in the order written and never cut. A claim is open while its last fact is atlax_claim; a later atlax_claim replaces its designations (Hestia's C1). Each fact's body holds to claim.schema.json (atlax_claim) or claim-release.schema.json (atlax_claim_released); test.py checks it by kind. The fact key at Hestia is card + artifact, the factory the batch's. Writers: `atlax claim` (supervise, when a card goes now), `atlax release` (the card's close), `atlax publish` (release, reason published). Readers: the record's laptop indexer (hestia's card atlax-claims, not written yet), `atlax publish` (open claims to release). Sample: claims-state.sample.json.

card.description: <initiative>/<card slug>; with artifact, the claim's key and the file's name.

branch.description: The card's branch when its front matter names one: `atlax publish` releases the claim when a commit since the claim names the card's slug or this branch. Local only, never in a fact's body.

at.description: UTC, when the fact was written.

body.description: The A4 claim body (claim.schema.json) or the A7 release body (claim-release.schema.json), by kind.
